title: 第七章 恒安鹰扬

content_zh:
云中之地，是一个被群山包裹的大盆地，而这群山，都是石山。树林中尽是嶙峋乱石，还有倒伏下来的枯木残根，星光从树林缝隙中洒下来，仿佛就如一片尸骸满地的修罗场一般。
八九条个身影，慢慢就从这枯木残根中站起身来。
这些身影，都是披着轻便简单的皮甲，头上未曾戴兜鍪，就是将头发简单束起。背上负弓，和弓囊交叉斜着一个撒袋，装满羽箭。这一撒袋羽箭用绳系紧，就是防止行动之中碰撞出声。
而每人腰间，还插着一柄直刀。另一边则是一个革囊，革囊中有火石，有盐，有醋布，还有三天分量的干粮。
这正是大隋军中装扮配备，看这每人携带的军资器物，应是一火的编制，撒出来为山间伏路的。
夜色中看不清这八九人面目，但是看他们举动，都是矫健轻捷，身上也直散发出淡淡的血腥味道，不是经历过战场，从死人堆中摸爬滚打过一遭，难得给人这种感觉。
八九人不则声的悄悄聚集一处，带队火长压低声音询问：“山顶如何？”
一名军士低声回报：“都睡着了，只留一人守夜。”
又一名军士道：“这商队还算肥，二十驮子货，加上骡马，出手就能换五六十贯。不亏我们在山里伏了几天！”
带队火长似乎有些迟疑，一名军士急切的道：“火长，还想甚么！苑校尉的号令，过往军中商队不走官道，反而穿行山间，不抽他们的税，让军中喝风不成！苑校尉就是要杀一儆百，收拾一下这些南面来的商队！”
周遭军士纷纷附和。
“可不是怎的！王仁恭拼命招兵买马，一文钱也不朝云中漏，马邑兵一个个富得流油，咱们恒安兵就是精穷！眼看得刘鹰击要和王太守决裂，两人谁胜谁败不好说，这个时候趁机往腰里装点钱要紧！”
“火长你是跟着刘鹰击去过高丽的老弟兄，有点什么过错，就算知道，刘鹰击也包容了。抢干净这个商队，又算得甚事？”
“陈大瘤子，他们那一队奉苑校尉号令伏路一遭，一队弟兄，人人都落了几贯开皇通宝下腰，现下新靴子也穿起来，酒肉不停，窑子里的塞种鞑靼娘们儿见着他们就眉花眼笑！好容易争得这么一个伏路的勾当，咱们本事还差过陈大瘤子他们不成？”
这一火人马，正是云中恒安鹰扬府的兵。
现下马邑两大鹰扬府，马邑鹰扬在王仁恭治下，王仁恭不断招兵买马，竭力搜刮供应军需，实力不断膨胀。
而云中的恒安鹰扬府，是鹰击郎将刘武周统领。
王仁恭是琅琊王家后裔，正经世家子弟，朝中多有奥援，坐镇马邑日久。中原局势日非，大业天子南下江都，说是巡幸也好，说是逃避也好。临走之前还是尽到了大隋天子的责任，尽力对各地做了一番布置，对于这些久在其任，有兵有将有背景的地方郡守进行了牵制。
刘武周就是从从征高丽的军队中为大业天子亲手提拔起来的人物，回到马邑郡就接掌了恒安鹰扬府，就是为分王仁恭的权力。
心高气傲，刚愎自用，年前才击败了突厥南下兵马一次，自诩为天下之雄，对于现在中原纷乱局势别有想法的王仁恭，如何能承受得了？

现下中原处处起火冒烟，河北窦建德起兵，瓦岗军攻城略地，萧铣截断运河，洛阳王世充据洛口黎阳两仓别有盘算。
王仁恭就欲一统郡中兵马，未尝没有携天下闻名的云中精兵南下分一杯羹的意思！
攘外必先安内，王仁恭一边招兵买马，一边就是用各种手段逼迫着身在云中的刘武周。
马邑鹰扬兵不断北调，压迫刘武周。另外郡中已经不拨一文钱一粒粮至云中。
刘武周苦苦支撑着云中局面，维持着以他从高丽带回来的老弟兄班底组成的恒安鹰扬府。一边睁大了眼睛到处寻觅哪里能有财源。
经云中通往草原的商路，就成了刘武周打主意的目标。商队过得多，抽的税就多，就能养得起兵马！只要有兵在手，乱世中就有自家一份地位！
但是马邑郡叠经和突厥人的战事，现下王仁恭和刘武周两雄在郡中对立，哪里还有多少商队还能安心继续做生意？就算是还有胆子大的，也如徐乐这支队伍一般，穿行在群山之间，绕过官道前往草原。不然这点商货，都不够王仁恭和刘武周两家抽税来着。

content_en:
The land in the clouds is a large basin surrounded by mountains, and these mountains are all stone mountains. The woods are full of jagged rocks and fallen dead tree roots. Starlight shines down from the gaps in the woods, making it look like a Shura field filled with corpses.
Eighty-nine figures slowly stood up from the dead tree roots.
These figures were all wearing light and simple leather armor. They did not wear hoods on their heads, but simply tied up their hair. There is a bow on his back, and a bag filled with feathers and arrows crossed with the bow pouch. This bag of feathers and arrows is tied tightly with a rope to prevent them from colliding and making noise during action.
And each person also has a straight knife stuck in his waist. On the other side is a leather bag, which contains flint, salt, vinegar cloth, and three days' worth of dry food.
This is exactly what the Sui army was equipped with. Judging from the military equipment carried by each person, it should be a fire formation, spread out to cover the mountains.
The faces of these eight or nine people could not be seen clearly in the night, but their movements were all vigorous and agile, and they always exuded a faint smell of blood. It was rare to give people this feeling unless they had experienced the battlefield and had to crawl through a pile of dead people.
Eight or nine people quietly gathered together, and the leader of the fire team asked in a low voice: "How is the top of the mountain?"
A sergeant reported in a low voice: "Everyone is asleep, only one person is left to keep watch."
Another sergeant said: "This caravan is quite fat. Twenty loads of goods, plus mules and horses, can be exchanged for fifty or sixty guans. We spent a few days in the mountains!"
The fire chief who led the team seemed to be hesitant, and a sergeant said eagerly: "Fire chief, what are you thinking about! Captain Yuan's order is that the passing military caravans will not take the official road, but will walk through the mountains instead of taxing them, which will make the army unhappy! Captain Yuan just wants to kill these caravans from the south!"
The surrounding soldiers all agreed.
"That's not what happened! Wang Rengong tried his best to recruit troops and horses, and did not leak a penny to the clouds. Every one of the Ma Yi soldiers was extremely rich, but our Heng'an soldiers were poor! Seeing that Liu Yingqi was about to break with Wang Taishou, it was hard to say who would win and who would lose. At this time, it was important to take the opportunity to put some money in his waist!"
"Chief Huo, you are an old brother who followed Liu Yingchun to Goryeo. If you made any mistakes, even if you knew about them, Liu Yingchun tolerated them. What does it mean to rob this caravan?"
"Chen Dazuzi, their team was ambushed by Captain Yuan's order. Everyone in the group has lost a few Kaihuang Tongbao waists. Now they are wearing new boots. They are drinking and eating all the time. The Tatar girls in the brothel are beaming when they see them! It's so easy to win such an ambush. Are we still worse than Chen Dazuzi and the others?"
These fire men and horses are the soldiers of Yingyang Mansion in Hengan, Yunzhong.
Now there are two major Yingyang mansions in Mayi. Yingyang in Mayi is under the rule of Wang Rengong. Wang Rengong continues to recruit troops and horses, and strives to plunder and supply military supplies, and his strength continues to expand.
As for the Yingyang Mansion in Heng'an in the clouds, it was led by Liu Wuzhou, the general of Yingshitang.
Wang Rengong was a descendant of the Langya royal family, a member of a serious family. He had many aids in the court and had been in charge of Mayi for a long time. The situation in the Central Plains was deteriorating day by day. Emperor Daye went south to Jiangdu, saying it was a patrol or an escape. Before leaving, he still fulfilled his responsibilities as the Emperor of the Sui Dynasty and tried his best to make arrangements for various places. He also restrained the local governors who had been in office for a long time and had soldiers, generals and backgrounds.
Liu Wuzhou was personally promoted by Emperor Daye from the army that conquered Goryeo. When he returned to Mayi County, he took over the Yingyang Mansion in Heng'an in order to share Wang Rengong's power.
How could Wang Rengong, who was arrogant and self-willed and had defeated the Turks' southward troops just once a year ago and claimed to be the hero of the world, and who had other ideas about the current chaotic situation in the Central Plains, bear it?
Now there are fires and smoke everywhere in the Central Plains. Dou Jiande of Hebei Province raises troops, Wagang army attacks the city and seizes territory, Xiao Mian cuts off the canal, and Wang Shichong of Luoyang seizes the two warehouses in Luokou and Liyang with his own plans.
Wang Rengong wants oneThe soldiers and horses in the unified county may not be without the intention of taking the world-famous Yunzhong elite soldiers southward to get a share of the pie!
To fight against the outside world, one must first pacify the inside. While Wang Rengong was recruiting troops, he was using various means to force Liu Wuzhou who was in the clouds.
Ma Yiying raised his troops and continuously transferred his troops to the north to suppress Liu Wuzhou. In addition, the county has not allocated a penny or a grain of grain to Yunzhong.
Liu Wuzhou worked hard to support the situation in Yunzhong and maintain the Heng'an Yingyang Mansion composed of the old brothers he brought back from Goryeo. While opening his eyes wide, he looked around for sources of wealth.
The trade route leading to the grassland through Yunzhong became Liu Wuzhou's target. The more caravans pass through, the more taxes will be collected, and they will be able to afford soldiers and horses! As long as you have soldiers in hand, you will have a place in troubled times!
However, the war between Diejing and the Turks in Mayi County, and now that Wang Rengong and Liu Wuzhou are facing each other in the county, how many caravans can continue to do business with peace of mind? Even those who were brave enough, like Xu Le's team, walked through the mountains and bypassed the official road to the grassland. Otherwise, this small amount of commercial goods would not be enough for Wang Rengong and Liu Wuzhou to collect taxes.
